purpose: Independent practice of B2.4 (modelling story problems with totals to 100) and B2.1 (relationship between add/sub via check-by-reversing).
student_learning_goal: I can act out, draw, and write an equation for an addition or subtraction story problem with totals up to 100, and check by reversing.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can act out, draw, and write an equation for an addition or subtraction story problem with totals up to 100, and check by reversing.
header.character_watermark: Mae the Multiplier in the top-right corner with her workshop apron. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Sketch a tape diagram showing both parts. Write an addition equation. Add a check sentence.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Two story-problem boxes side by side.

image_placeholders.description: Two story-problem boxes in B&W line-art, side by side, each ~3.5in × 3in. Box A story: 'Mae had 47 paper kittens. Buddy delivered 36 more. How many altogether?' Box B story: 'Dan had 58 paper cookies. Mae baked 27 more. How many cookies now?' Below each: blank tape-diagram, equation line, AND check-equation line.
image_placeholders.placement: Top of the page; two boxes side by side.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_TWO_CHANGE_ADD: keywords (story, tape-diagram) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: Box A: tape diagram parts 47 and 36, total 83. Equation 47+36=83. Check 83-36=47. Box B: tape diagram parts 58 and 27, total 85. Equation 58+27=85. Check 85-27=58.

parts.student_instructions: Show the take-from action with a tape diagram. Write a subtraction equation. Add an addition check.
parts.visual_layout: Upper-middle. Two story-problem boxes side by side.

image_placeholders.description: Two story-problem boxes in B&W line-art, side by side, each ~3.5in × 3in. Box A story: 'Mae had 75 paper cookies. She used 28 for a baking demo. How many left?' Box B story: 'Dan had 92 paper kittens. He gave 38 to friends. How many remain?' Below each: blank tape-diagram, equation line, AND check-equation line.
image_placeholders.placement: Upper-middle; two boxes side by side.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_TWO_CHANGE_TAKE: keywords (story, subtraction) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: Box A: tape diagram parts 28 (used) and 47 (left), total 75. Equation 75-28=47. Check 47+28=75. Box B: tape diagram parts 38 (given) and 54 (left), total 92. Equation 92-38=54. Check 54+38=92.

parts.student_instructions: Sketch the part-part-whole on a tape diagram. Write the equation. Solve and circle the answer.
parts.visual_layout: Middle-lower. Two story-problem boxes side by side.

How many items total?' Box B story (missing-addend): 'Dan and Buddy collected 84 acorns altogether. Dan collected 39. How many did Buddy collect?' Below each: blank tape-diagram and equation line.

parts.student_instructions: Write your own change-take-from story with totals near 80. Draw a tape diagram. Write the equation. Check.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. A blank box for the child to write a story, draw a diagram, write the equation, and check.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any plausible change-take-from story with totals near 80, including diagram, correct equation, and a valid check.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a SECOND story on the back — a part-part-whole story with a missing addend.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Hand out at the end of the Action phase. Watch for: (a) children who skip the tape diagram — flag for diagram-as-thinking-tool reteach; (b) children who skip the check — flag for the relationship-as-tool reteach; (c) Part 4 children whose equation doesn't match their story — coaching on problem-type identification.
